gaps.sentence: The dogs’ astonishing ___ (LOYAL) to their owners is well documented.
gaps.explanation: 'Astonishing loyalty' — the quality noun is required after the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.

gaps.explanation: 'Directly contradictory' — the adjective meaning they cannot both be true.

gaps.sentence: The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.

gaps.sentence: The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
